name: malbit
description: 말빛 - 공손한 말 변환기 & 대화 응답기

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css app.js dist/ && echo "const express = require('express'); const path = require('path'); const app = express(); const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000; app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname))); app.get('/', (req, res) => { res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html')); }); app.listen(PORT, () => { console.log(\`Server running on port \${PORT}\`); });" > dist/server.js && cp package.json .env dist/
